fullPassage: Good design starts with an understanding of psychology and technology. Good design requires good communication, especially from machine to person, indicating what actions are possible, what is happening, and what is about to happen. Communication is especially important when things go wrong. It is relatively easy to design things that work smoothly and harmoniously as long as things go right. But as soon as there is a problem or a misunderstanding, the problems arise and this is where good design is essential. Designers need to focus their attention on the cases where things go wrong, not just on when things work as planned. Actually, this is where the most satisfaction can arise: when something goes wrong but the machine highlights the problems, then the person understands the issue, takes the proper actions, and the problem is solved.

questions.passage: Good design requires good communication, especially from machine to person, __________ (indicate) what actions are possible, what is happening, and what is about to happen.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: indicate → indicating: 앞 문장을 부연 설명하는 분사구문(현재분사)
det.analysis: indicate(동사원형) → indicating(현재분사). 콤마 뒤에서 앞 절 전체를 보충 설명하는 분사구문. '~하면서/~을 나타내며'로 해석. 능동 의미이므로 -ing 현재분사
det.tip: 분사구문: 콤마 뒤 동사를 -ing로. indicating=나타내면서(능동)

questions.passage: Good design starts with an __________ (understand) of psychology and technology. Communication is especially important when things go wrong.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: understand → understanding: 관사 an 뒤에 오는 명사 형태
det.analysis: understand(동사) → understanding(명사). 부정관사 an 다음에는 명사가 와야 함. 'an understanding of ~'=~에 대한 이해. 동사를 -ing 형태의 명사(동명사성 명사)로 전환
det.tip: an + 명사. understand(동사)를 understanding(명사)으로 변환. an understanding of=~의 이해

questions.passage: Good design starts with an understanding of psychology and technology. Good design requires good communication, especially from machine to person, indicating what actions are possible, what is happening, and what is __________. Communication is especially important when things go wrong. It is relatively easy to design things that work smoothly and harmoniously as long as things go right. But as soon as there is a problem or a misunderstanding, the problems arise and this is where good design is essential. Designers need to focus their attention on the cases where things go wrong, not just on when things work as planned. Actually, this is where the most satisfaction can arise: when something goes wrong but the machine highlights the problems, then the person understands the issue, takes the proper actions, and the problem is solved.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어떤 행동이 가능한지, 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는지, 그리고 무엇이 ______인지 알려주기
det.analysis:
❌ ① already finished(이미 끝난): 미래 시점을 알린다는 흐름과 반대
✅ ② about to happen(막 일어나려는): possible/happening/about to happen — 과거·현재·미래의 병렬 ← 정답
❌ ③ no longer possible(더 이상 불가능한): 앞의 possible과 모순
❌ ④ impossible to change(바꿀 수 없는): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: be about to happen=막 일어나려 하다. what is possible / happening / about to happen 병렬 구조

questions.passage: Good design starts with an understanding of psychology and technology. Good design requires good communication, especially from machine to person, indicating what actions are possible, what is happening, and what is about to happen. Communication is especially important when things go wrong. It is relatively easy to design things that work smoothly and harmoniously as long as things go right. But as soon as there is a problem or a misunderstanding, the problems arise and this is where good design is essential. Designers need to focus their attention on the cases where things go wrong, not just on when things work as planned. Actually, this is where the most satisfaction can arise: when something goes wrong but the machine highlights the problems, then the person understands the issue, __________, and the problem is solved.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사람이 문제를 이해하고 ______, 그리고 문제가 해결된다
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignores the warning signs(경고를 무시한다): 무시하면 문제 해결로 이어지지 않음
❌ ② repeats the same mistake(같은 실수를 반복한다): 해결과 모순
✅ ③ takes the proper actions(적절한 조치를 취한다): 이해 → 적절한 조치 → 해결의 흐름 ← 정답
❌ ④ shuts everything down(모두 꺼버린다): 문제 해결이 아닌 중단
det.tip: take proper actions=적절한 조치를 취하다. 이해→조치→해결의 인과 흐름
